about: The plug-ins the Earth Atlas offers to load (ADR 0027). Each file exports create(api); see README.md.

plugins.title: vorticity and divergence
plugins.description: Relative vorticity and divergence of the wind, by centred differences on the sphere.

plugins.title: air parcels
plugins.description: Parcels carried through the wind from a ring around the chosen place, or a lattice over the globe.

plugins.title: optimal interpolation
plugins.description: A background analysed toward observations taken from a second model at a lattice of points.

plugins.title: the barotropic model
plugins.description: The barotropic vorticity equation from the 500 hPa wind, verified against the source.

plugins.title: vorticity and divergence (Python)
plugins.description: The same diagnostic written in Python, run by the server on numpy.

plugins.title: vorticity and divergence (C++)
plugins.description: The same diagnostic written in C++, compiled and run by the server; needs a C++ compiler on the serving computer.
